title: Enterprise Final Frontier - is it possible to change the corporate ways in product development?

seo.description: A tale of the biggest challenges and adventures of developing a vast digital product in a cross-team enterprise environment.

blocks.html:
What can go sideways while building a multi-purpose, micro front-end-based platform comprising 30 applications? How can 5 front-end teams, 2 design teams, and 30 product managers work together to transform a vast information environment to deliver the best experience for 2,6 M users daily?
On the enterprise level of product development, we encounter problems that fit in on a whole new scale of ‘troublesome.’ The smallest thing may escalate quickly and affect the entire ecosystem. We’re always to consider the bigger picture. See the real-life case of how we’re transforming the everyday work frame and project strategy and find out why a Design Lead is telling this story.
